answer: Attention-Bonded Queuing. Each identity must hold a distinct live queue slot, drawn from a shared river of task requests, and keep a minimum active rate over each epoch. Slots are capped per verified hardware root, so extra identities must idle in a meadow of pending slots that earns nothing. Enforcement: idle rate below threshold forfeits the slot and its accrued onyx credits. An attacker pays sustained human-equivalent attention per identity, scaling cost linearly with fake identities.
